messages:
Alex Kim: quick Q — thinking about adding a "tenant visibility summary" in Console for routing/quota surface. a compact card per tenant that shows top routes, who can see them, and any scoped limits. would help SREs and PMs. (1809990123)
Maya Patel: +1. we keep getting asks for a single-page snapshot. should be lightweight — not full route list. maybe top-3 by spend/reqs and a dropdown for details. (1809990450)
Jorge Rivera: agree. propose: show top-3 routes, a small "visibility" pill (tenant/org/private), and an expandable list with per-route quota+last-deploy. expansion can lazy-load. (1809990580)
Lucy Chen: important: permissions scoping. tenant-admins should only see tenant-scoped routes; org-admins see everything. also need a clear affordance for routes that exist but are hidden due to perms. (1809990701)
Alex Kim: UX idea: show hidden routes as "Masked (request access)" with a CTA that creates a ticket or sends an access request to org-admins. prevents accidental leak. (1809990899)
Maya Patel: telemetry question — what metrics do we surface on the card? thinking: 24h token cost, 24h requests, and latency distribution sample. sampling rate matters for cost. (1809990944)
Jorge Rivera: backend change needed: authz api should return visibility flag per route to avoid expensive per-route permission checks. e.g.
```
{"route_id":"r-123","display_name":"/summaries","visibility":"tenant"}
```
cache TTL maybe 5m. considerations: stale visibility vs immediate permission revocation. (1809991022)
Lucy Chen: also require audit fields: who last viewed and when, and the last time a role change affected visibility. enterprise legal will want retention options. (1809991120)
infra-bot: Notice: expanding per-route details could trigger additional permission checks — plan rate limit increase or batching. Estimated QPS bump: +15% for initial rollout. (automated) (1809991200)
Alex Kim: rollout plan: feature-flagged, canary to 10% tenants, monitor authz error rate and UI latency. fallback: hide summaries if authz errors spike. (1809991367)
Maya Patel: I'll mock the compact card + "masked" microcopy. will add tooltip: "You don't currently have permission to view this route — request access". want to iterate with legal on wording. (1809991450)
Jorge Rivera: I'll add the visibility field to the /routes list response and a new condensed endpoint /tenants/:id/route-summary that returns top-k metrics. will include ETag for caching. (1809991533)
Lucy Chen: final note: server-side enforcement only. UI can show helpful affordances but don't rely on client-side filtering for security. will add to API spec review. (1809991610)
Alex Kim: next steps: @Maya prototype by Tue EOD, @Jorge API spec PR next Wed, @Lucy enterprise requirements doc by next Thu. sync in #eng-platform next Thu 11am. :thumbsup: (1809991700)
